# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `tanatasa` MCP server pointing at Tanatasa's hosted endpoint (`https://tanatasa.sg/mcp`).
- No sign-in required for guest carts; OAuth sign-in is optional.
- Logo references `https://tanatasa.sg/icon-512.png`; the image could not be downloaded when this plugin was added.
